name: GLONASS
tagline: Russia's GNSS — 24 sats, restored to full coverage in 2011
description: Russia's GNSS — 24 active satellites at 19,130 km MEO in 3 planes inclined 64.8° (the high inclination is deliberate for better high-latitude coverage relative to GPS). First launched 1982; reached full constellation in 1995, then collapsed in the late 1990s / early 2000s after Soviet funding ended; restored to full 24-satellite operational status around 2010-2011 with funding revival. Continues operational in 2026. Operated by Roscosmos in coordination with the Russian Ministry of Defence.
best_known_for: Russia's GNSS — 24 sats, restored to full coverage in 2011
